title: Curling is a game of touch and tactics more than strength
alt: Dozens of rounded granite curling stones in grey, pink and white, arranged in tiers on a bed of gravel beside a lawn.

posts.facebook:
Two teams slide granite stones down the ice towards a target called the house, and sweeping in front of a stone changes how far it travels and how much it curls. A taster session gets you delivering a stone within the hour, with brushes, sliders and stones supplied. Rinks have ice from autumn to spring.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/try-curling/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
